label: Gala

provenance.incarnation: MG2 revised official released-port Dr Drago Pettrovich Madnar: elderly pale man, balding high forehead, gray hair at sides, gray moustache, stern lined long face, baseline proportions. Not an MGS4 reappearance or the original celebrity-based MG2 portrait. Original CQC gala outfit; no official retail gala costume claimed.
